sql:
WITH q AS (
  SELECT quarter, MEASURE(aa_revenue) AS aa_revenue, MEASURE(aa_share) AS aa_share, MEASURE(fair_share) AS fair_share,
         MEASURE(share_gap_pts) AS share_gap_pts, MEASURE(aa_pax) AS aa_pax
  FROM aa_demo.gold.sales_metrics
  WHERE agency = 'Summit Travel Partners' AND market = 'DFW-ORD' AND quarter IN ('Q3 2025', 'Q3 2026')
  GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT quarter, ROUND(aa_revenue) AS aa_revenue,
       ROUND(try_divide((aa_revenue - LAG(aa_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY quarter)),LAG(aa_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY quarter)) * 100, 1) AS revenue_change_pct,
       ROUND(aa_share * 100, 1) AS aa_share_pct, ROUND(fair_share * 100, 1) AS fair_share_pct, ROUND(share_gap_pts, 1) AS share_gap_pts, aa_pax
FROM q ORDER BY quarter

sql:
WITH rev AS (
  SELECT `agency`, ROUND(MEASURE(`aa_revenue`)) AS aa_revenue_2026_09,
         ROUND(MEASURE(`aa_revenue_prior_year`)) AS aa_revenue_2025_09,
         ROUND(MEASURE(`yoy_revenue_pct`) * 100, 1) AS delta_pct
  FROM aa_demo.gold.sales_metrics
  WHERE sales_month = DATE '2026-09-01'
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT a.agency_name, r.aa_revenue_2026_09, r.aa_revenue_2025_09, r.delta_pct, p.pace_pct
FROM rev r
JOIN aa_demo.gold.dim_agency a ON a.agency_name = r.agency
JOIN aa_demo.gold.agency_pace p ON p.agency_id = a.agency_id
WHERE p.sales_month = DATE '2026-09-01' AND p.goal_year = 2026
ORDER BY r.delta_pct ASC
